{{WAW WOT}}
<div align="center"><youtube>MZd2CpLamwk</youtube></div>
==Errors==
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=0m13s|text=0:13}} There were other divisions in the [[White Tower]], including '''''six''''' mutinies.{{ref/book|7|12}}
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m05s|text=1:05}} Finding [[Amys]] in {{tar}} was '''not''' a test to see if [[Egwene]] still needed to learn. It was merely one of many tasks [[Amys]] set for her. It was basically homework.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m43s|text=1:43}} The timeline is completely out of whack and the basic facts are simply wrong. Egwene and [[Moiraine]] met with the [[Wise Ones]] at [[Rhuidean]] weeks or months before the [[Second Battle of Cairhien]], when the remaining undeclared clans joined [[Rand]]. Moiraine did '''not''' "refuse" to meet with the Wise Ones. She was with Egwene while they both met with the Wise Ones, which resulted in her going to [[Rhuidean]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m25s|text=2:25}} The wording makes it sound like Egwene is being granted initial permission to enter {{tar}}. The Wise Ones were actually restoring permission to enter {{tar|link=no}} following their temporary prohibition due to her need for rest and recovery.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m32s|text=2:32}} The Salidar Aes Sedai did not "recommend" that she appear there as soon as possible. They '''''ordered''''' her to answer the summons as soon as possible.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m48s|text=2:48}} The Wise Ones did '''not''' open the [[Gateway]] to {{tar|link=no}}. They refused to even help Egwene learn how. She had to learn how and actually do it by herself.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m14s|text=3:14}} The wording makes it sound like the [[Red Ajah]] had really propped up [[Logain]] as a [[false Dragon]]. But [[Siuan]] made that up; the Red Ajah had no hand in Logain becoming a false Dragon.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m20s|text=3:20}} The on-screen note is categorically false. Logain did not tell Siuan/[[Leane]] any such thing. Siuan made it up for him.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m24s|text=3:24}} Describing [[Thom]], [[Juilin]], and [[Elayne]] as "[[Tanchico]] comrades" is weird considering none of them were Tanchican, and it ignores [[Uno]] and the others who joined them after they'd already left [[Tarabon]], much less Tanchico.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=4m00s|text=4:00}} It makes no sense whatsoever to say that Egwene's election "still" "had to take place through voting." This implies there was something about the possibility of electing Egwene that would negate the need for voting, which is nonsense.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=4m04s|text=4:04}} No, Egwene's raising in [[Salidar]] was '''not''' the second time Egwene was elected Amyrlin. That happened '''months''' later by a completely different electorate! What they're trying and failing to convey is that it took two rounds of voting to elect Egwene the first time.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=4m14s|text=4:14}} The raising of [[Nynaeve]] and the others was not "despite [[Sheriam|Sheriam's]] objections" which weren't voiced until after the fact.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=4m42s|text=4:42}} [[Rand]] did '''not''' ask [[Mat]] to follow Egwene to "support her among the other Aes Sedai." He sent Mat primarily to retrieve Elayne and secondarily to bring Egwene and all the Aes Sedai to him if possible.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=5m03s|text=5:03}} Egwene did '''not''' decide to use "the Shienaran" at all. Setting aside that "the Shienaran" is [[Uno]] - a person, not a thing "which came with Nynaeve" - it was [[Gareth Bryne]] who recruited Uno.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=6m04s|text=6:04}} The fixing of the weather has no connection whatsoever to Rand's return from the [[Aiel Waste]] and it's weird to call it out. The AI probably spat this out because Rand notices the weather is too warm after he returns to the [[Westlands]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=8m42s|text=8:42}} ROFL. No, they did '''''not''''' stretch chains across the river. They used the chains that already existed across the mouths of the [[Tar Valon]] harbors.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=8m42s|text=8:42}} ''[[Cuendillar]]'' is a material, not a thing. "A cuendillar" is as nonsensical as "a gold" or "a rutherfordium."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=8m51s|text=8:51}} [[Egwene]] did '''not''' decide to "accompany them." She was not accompanying [[Leane]]. But more importantly, she ''replaced'' Bode.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=8m58s|text=8:58}} The idea that Egwene was captured on the bank of the river is ludicrous. This all occurred at the mouth of the harbor. And, again, Leane was not present there; she was at the complete opposite end of the city.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=11m53s|text=11:53}} I don't know where "three novices" comes from. There were many more than that.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=13m14s|text=13:14}} The wording implies the loyalist Sitters came to the rebel camp. They came to a [[Tar Valon]] bridge just as Egwene was about to commence the assault on the city.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=13m33s|text=13:33}} The wording seems to imply a connection between the reunification of the White Tower and the weather being fixed. There is no such connection beyond the triviality that Aes Sedai participated in fixing the weather.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=13m52s|text=13:52}} The [[Shaido]] were ''not'' a rising threat in the aftermath of the White Tower's unification. The accumulation of ''[[raken]]'' for the raid occurred while [[Perrin]] and [[Tylee]] were gathering ''raken'' themselves for the Shaido attack, and Perrin and Tylee had [[Traveling]], unlike the [[Seanchan]] raiding force.
==Nitpicks==
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=0m46s|text=0:46}} [[Egwene]] is not the "[[Amyrlin Seat]] of [[Emond's Field]]." She's the Amyrlin Seat of the [[Aes Sedai]] and she's ''from'' Emond's Field.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=0m55s|text=0:55}} Egwene trained under the [[Wise Ones]] (plural) not "the Wise One" which doesn't make any sense.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m11s|text=1:11}} Technically the [[Aiel]] were "faithful to the [[Dragon Reborn]]," but it would be more accurate to say that they were faithful to the ''[[Car'a'carn]]'', or simply to [[Rand]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m15s|text=1:15}} A clarification since the video leaves this ambiguous: Egwene met with Nynaeve via {{tar}}. Nynaeve was in the southwestern [[Westlands]], not traveling with the [[Aiel]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m27s|text=1:27}} They met ''in'' the [[World of Dreams]]. Meeting "at" the World of Dreams makes no sense.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m44s|text=1:44}} The neutral Aiel clans joined '''the''' ''Car'a'carn''. "To join ''Car'a'carn''" doesn't make any sense.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m49s|text=1:49}} Technically, [[Moiraine]] was indeed "following in the company of the Chief of Chiefs," but it would be far more accurate to say that she was accompanying Rand.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=1m59s|text=1:59}} Not sure why it isn't mentioned, but Egwene was seriously injured in the [[Lanfear]] incident and needed weeks of recovery.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m04s|text=2:04}} The wording misses the significance. Egwene (a) happened to see the [[White Tower Schism|loyalist Aes Sedai]] as they arrived in [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]], and (b) spied on them later. She did not passively "watch the arrival of [the] delegation."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m22s|text=2:22}} "Behind the scenes" is a misleading descriptor. Egwene simply observed the meeting between Rand and the loyalist Aes Sedai from behind a weave he wove to render her invisible to them.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m30s|text=2:30}} Egwene was not summoned "''in front of'' the [[Hall of the Tower]]" - either the physical place or its reflection in {{tar|link=no}} or the abstract term for the collected [[Sitters]]. She was summoned ''to'' the Hall of the Tower (the [[Salidar]] Sitters).
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=2m44s|text=2:44}} The whipping was '''not''' satisfying the ''toh'' of the "[[Aiel]] women." It was discharging '''Egwene's''' ''toh'' '''to''' the Aiel women.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m00s|text=3:00}} Egwene could indeed sense the ability to channel in Siuan, but she could do that before even leaving [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]]. What actually happened was that Egwene realized Siuan's identity after arriving in Salidar based on her speech and mannerisms, not her ability to channel.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m10s|text=3:10}} Siuan's and Leane's machinations were not really "inciting" conflict with the White Tower so much as exacerbating it.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m37s|text=3:37}} I wouldn't say Nynaeve "filled" a gap in [[Logain]] so much as "bridged" it.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m38s|text=3:38}} Nynaeve didn't Heal Logain "unwillingly" so much as "unwittingly."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=3m49s|text=3:49}} I wouldn't say Sheriam wanted Egwene's election to proceed as "legally" as possible so much as she wanted it to be as credible as possible. They were exploiting a loophole, which is not the action of someone pursuing the path of maximum legality. Also, all this had nothing to do with Sheriam informing Egwene of the reasoning, which the wording implies.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=4m30s|text=4:30}} Siuan didn't so much offer her help as gradually become a loyal advisor after being assigned to Egwene as a glorified tutor.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=4m51s|text=4:51}} [[Mat]] did not really go to [[Ebou Dar]] at "Egwene's request." He went because Elayne went and he had to follow her to fulfill his promise to Rand.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=5m00s|text=5:00}} The [[Band of the Red Hand]] remained ''near'' Salidar, but certainly not "in" Salidar.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=5m13s|text=5:13}} The nation of [[Murandy]] is not called "Muranda." A Murandian is not called a "Murandan."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=5m30s|text=5:30}} It is inaccurate to refer to the assembled Andorans and Murandians as "the Murandian army." The Andorans were the leaders and probably more numerous than the Murandians.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=5m32s|text=5:32}} Describing Egwene's announcement as "recruitment for novices was open," while true, completely misses the significance that '''all''' woman who could channel could be accepted as a novice.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=6m27s|text=6:27}} The Kin were found and predominantly based in coastal [[Ebou Dar]], so it's weird to depict them as standing in a random plain amongst mountains.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=6m47s|text=6:47}} When "all four of them" went they had over a dozen other people with them.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=8m30s|text=8:30}} A "Sitting" is not a term. The [[Hall]] was convened, and the Hall is composed of [[Sitters]], but such convocations are never called "Sittings."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=9m11s|text=9:11}} "Ajah" is singular. "Ajahs" is plural. "The various Ajah" is incorrect.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=9m29s|text=9:29}} The wording makes it sound like Egwene's Tower captivity was while the rebel Aes Sedai were still in [[Salidar]], which is silly.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=11m07s|text=11:07}} [[Moria]] was '''''a''''' Sitter, not "the" Sitter. [[Ajahs]] have three Sitters each.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/MZd2CpLamwk?t=12m31s|text=12:31}} There were no horseman in the Egwene rescue attempt. There were a hundred soldiers with [[Gawyn]], [[Siuan]], and [[Bryne]], not horsemen.
{{notes}}
